label: v53.66
changes: Restored the Supabase publishable API key headers used by the previously working Navigator loader; v53.65 omitted them from live bundle requests
Removed the over-broad bundle validation rule that could reject a real Navigator bundle just because it contained a generic id=view element
Added recovery of legacy saved six-digit device access from older Navigator storage keys without showing a password prompt
Preserved all previous private Navigator caches and kept cached-first recovery
Updated the Nova visual layer so My Job can replace the compact summary card even before full job detail has been opened, fixing the old oversized green card on mobile
Added bounded startup visual retries only; no MutationObserver and no continuous polling loop
Preserved shared task progress, DONE history, assignments, holds, crew identity and Morning Pack data
